questions.stem: 遠距醫療（telemedicine）讓醫生能透過網路為病人看診，這對住在偏遠地區的人特別有幫助。
questions.answer: Telemedicine enables doctors to see patients through the Internet, which is especially helpful for people who live in remote areas.
accepted_answers: Telemedicine allows doctors to examine patients over the Internet, which is particularly helpful to people who live in remote areas.
Telemedicine lets doctors see and treat patients through the Internet, which is especially helpful to those who live in remote areas.

patterns: 非限定關係子句（which 指前面整件事：…, which is …）
關係代名詞限定子句（住在偏遠地區的人＝people who live in remote areas）

questions.stem: 在年輕人大多已搬走的鄉村，這項服務已被用來照顧獨居的長者。
questions.answer: In rural villages where most young people have moved away, this service has been used to care for elderly residents who live alone.
accepted_answers: In rural areas where most of the young people have left, this service has been used to take care of old people living alone.
In villages from which most young people have moved away, this service has been used to look after elderly people who live by themselves.

patterns: 關係副詞 where（年輕人已搬走的鄉村＝villages where …）

1.explanation_zh: 「，這對…特別有幫助」的「這」指的是「醫生能透過網路看診」這整件事，英文用逗號加 which（非限定關係子句，which 可以指前面整句），不要用逗號直接接 this is …。「住在偏遠地區的人」改成後位的限定關係子句 people who live in remote areas。「讓醫生能…」用 enable／allow doctors to VR；「看診」是 see／examine patients。
evidence: 這對住在偏遠地區的人特別有幫助
1.strategy_zh: 先寫主要子句 Telemedicine enables doctors to see patients …，逗號後用 which 補充評論，評論裡再用 who 子句修飾「人」。
hints: 切成四段：遠距醫療讓醫生能／透過網路為病人看診／住在偏遠地區的人／特別有幫助
標的詞彙：enable（使能夠）、patient（病人）、Internet（網路）、helpful（有幫助的）、remote（偏遠的）
句型框架：S + V …, which is especially + adj. + for people who + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「年輕人大多已搬走的鄉村」修飾語是完整子句，缺的是地點，用關係副詞 where：rural villages where most young people have moved away（move away 不及物，不能用 which）。「已被用來照顧」用完成式被動 has been used to care for；注意 be used to VR（被用來）和 be used to V-ing（習慣於）不同。「獨居的長者」是 elderly people who live alone，不是 lonely old people。
evidence: 年輕人大多已搬走的鄉村
已被用來照顧獨居的長者
2.strategy_zh: 句首地點片語 In rural villages 後面接 where 子句；主要子句 this service has been used to VR；最後用 who 子句修飾長者。
hints: 切成四段：在年輕人大多已搬走的鄉村／這項服務／已被用來照顧／獨居的長者
標的詞彙：rural（鄉村的）、service（服務）、care for（照顧）、elderly（年長的）
句型框架：In + N(地方) + where + S + have p.p., S + has been used to VR …

traps.literal_error: allows doctors to see a doctor for patients
traps.explanation_zh: 「看診」在這裡是醫生為病人診療，英文說 see／examine patients；see a doctor 是「病人去看醫生」，主客顛倒。

bonus.text: Thanks to telemedicine, doctors can now see patients online, a service that is especially helpful for those living in remote areas.
bonus.explanation_zh: 用 Thanks to … 開頭，再以同位語 a service that … 取代 which 子句，是另一種補充說明的進階寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「這對住在偏遠地區的人特別有幫助」的「這」指前面整件事，英文用 which 引導非限定子句接在逗號後面；「住在偏遠地區的人」改成 people who live in remote areas。

1.translation: Telemedicine allows doctors to see patients through the Internet, which is especially helpful to people living in remote areas.
1.explanation_zh: 「讓醫生能……」用 allows doctors to + V；「這對……特別有幫助」用 which 非限定關係子句指前面整件事；「住在偏遠地區的人」用現在分詞 people living in remote areas。

2.translation: In rural villages where most young people have already moved away, this service has been used to take care of elderly people who live alone.
2.explanation_zh: 「年輕人大多已搬走的鄉村」用關係副詞 where 的子句，搬走的動作已完成並影響現在，所以用現在完成式；「已被用來照顧」用現在完成式被動 has been used to + V；「獨居的長者」譯成 elderly people who live alone。

issues_zh: 「住在偏遠地區的人」我自然寫成現在分詞後位修飾 people living in remote areas（關係子句的省略形），沒有用 REL 要求的 people who live in remote areas；第 3 部分 accepted 只收 who live 的寫法。中文並沒有強制要用完整關係子句，REL 沒被引出，建議把 people living in remote areas 納入 accepted，或接受這個句型只能是『其中一種可接受寫法』。
